subject: Television & Streaming
title: The True Crime Obsession
description: One-minute skill: The True Crime Obsession.

hook.text: Making a Murderer aired on Netflix in 2015 and turned a Wisconsin case into a national obsession overnight.

buildup.text: True crime documentaries existed before streaming, but Netflix made them bingeable and socially contagious.

discovery.text: The genre exploded. Tiger King, The Staircase, and Dahmer dominated headlines and dinner conversations.

twist.text: Critics worried the genre exploited real victims for entertainment. Families of victims spoke out against the shows.

climax.text: True crime became streaming's most reliable genre—cheap to produce, easy to binge, and impossible to stop watching.

punchline.text: Streaming turned real tragedies into appointment viewing.

quiz.question: Which Netflix documentary helped launch the true crime streaming trend?
